description: This file defines functions for retrieving and manipulating chart theme colors, including CSS variable reading with fallbacks, and converting hex colors to RGBA format. It provides a public interface to generate a chart theme object based on CSS variables or default dark theme tokens.

methods.name: getCssVar(name, fallback)
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from the :root element, returning a fallback value if unavailable or in case of errors.

methods.name: withAlpha(hex, alpha, fallbackColor = "rgba(255,102,0,0.4)")
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGBA string with specified alpha transparency, with fallback on failure.

methods.name: getChartTheme()
methods.description: Generates a chart theme object based on CSS variables or dark theme tokens with predefined color tokens.
